Nadia, I've replied in your thread. Across #strategic-pod, #inc-vtg-hartford and Moss's Strategic digests, I found three confirmed Vantorre Group tickets and one that may be theirs.

- **INC-4821:** The Hartford status-page access issue. Source: #inc-vtg-hartford, Gideon, 2026-08-03.
- **VT-55120:** The root-cause ticket for the Hartford kiosk outage. Source: #inc-vtg-hartford, Gideon, 2026-10-14. I haven't opened it.
- **#8841:** It appears in the 4/27 digest (as #PD-8841), the 5/4 digest, Gideon's 7/1 message in #strategic-pod, and the 9/30 digest. The details differ between mentions. Gideon said on 7/1 that he closed it, yet the 9/30 digest has Mateo submitting it as new, at Newark. Please check whether it was reopened, the number was reused, or the digest got it wrong.
- **#PD-4418:** A Dock Door 9 export issue from the 9/15/2025 digest. That digest says only "the account Nadia runs", so I can't confirm it's Vantorre Group.

Several digest entries mention Vantorre Group issues without a ticket number. I listed those in the thread, along with the two tickets I left out because they belong to Mobility and Quillfeather.

This covers only those three sources. Anything in the ticketing system or in email won't show up here.
